انحنيت (form VII)
# اِنْحَنَيْتُ (inḥanaytu) /in.ħa.naj.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِنْحَنَى (inḥanā)
# اِنْحَنَيْتَ (inḥanayta) /in.ħa.naj.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِنْحَنَى (inḥanā)
# اِنْحَنَيْتِ (inḥanayti) /in.ħa.naj.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِنْحَنَى (inḥanā)
